Q00255_Tutorial/30008-001.htm.text: Grand Master Roien: Welcome. I am Grand Master Roien, of Sedrick's Training Hall. This school was established by the renowned Paladin Sir Sedrick, famous for producing many competent Fighters.. Did you get the Recommendation from the Newbie helper?

Q00255_Tutorial/30008-004.htm.text: Grand Master Roien: Go to Talking Island Village and meet the Newbie Guide. He will give you much important advice. He also has a gift for you.

Q00255_Tutorial/30008-003.htm.text: Grand Master Roien: First, you must learn the basic methods of control in the game. You should meet the Newbie Helper over there. Listen carefully to what he tells you, you will find it very useful later in the game.

Q00101_SwordOfSolidarity/30008-02.htm.text: Grand Master Roien: In the past, this island was where the Elves taught us Humans their magic. In the year marking the hundredth anniversary of the Humans coming to this remote island to learn the magic of the Elves, Human magicians commissioned a Dwarven craftsman to create a beautiful sword that …

links.text: Ask about the Sword of Solidarity

Q00101_SwordOfSolidarity/30008-08.htm.text: Grand Master Roien: Perhaps you have heard of the Sword of Solidarity? They say it is a fine blade treasured by the Elves that resided on this island long ago. These days, whenever I have the time I visit the libraries within Einhovant's School of Magic, to look through books and read stories relat…

Q00101_SwordOfSolidarity/30008-01.htm.text: Grand Master Roien: You have travelled quite far from your homeland, young stranger of a foreign race. I'm sorry, but I have no work for you. (Quest for Human characters level 9 and above.)

Q00101_SwordOfSolidarity/30008-05.html.text: Grand Master Roien: Please deliver my letter to Blacksmith Altran . You can find him at the village forge.

Q00101_SwordOfSolidarity/30008-11.html.text: Blacksmith Altran: Is this from the blade of the Sword of Solidarity? If only we could find the other half!

Q00101_SwordOfSolidarity/30008-10.html.text: Grand Master Roien: I heard that you are helping Altran. They say you are going to find the broken sword blade in the Elven Ruins. I wish you good luck!

Q00101_SwordOfSolidarity/30008-12.html.text: Blacksmith Altran: You've found the broken sword blades! Quickly, bring them to Altran!

Q00101_SwordOfSolidarity/30008-06.html.text: Grand Master Roien: You've found all the pieces of the broken blade?! What wonderful news! Now Altran can restore the Sword of Solidarity. But in order to do so, he's going to need the sword handle. Now, take this to Altran . Please tell him that it is given to him in thanks for all the help he has…

Q00101_SwordOfSolidarity/30008-07.html.text: Grand Master Roien: What, you haven't left yet? Go and deliver the sword handle to Blacksmith Altran immediately.

Q00101_SwordOfSolidarity/30008-03.html.text: Grand Master Roien: A thousand years ago, war arose between the Humans and the Elves, and the Elves were eventually defeated. The Elves of Talking Island said that the present they had received was not a Sword of Solidarity but a sword of betrayal, and broke the blade in half before leaving the isl…

Q00101_SwordOfSolidarity/30008-04.htm.text: Grand Master Roien: First, go and show this letter to Blacksmith Altran . In the letter, I have organized information that I've discovered regarding the Sword of Solidarity during my research of Ancient Scrolls at Einhovant's School of Magic. Altran says that his ancestors created the blade and ask…

Q00101_SwordOfSolidarity/30008-09.html.text: Grand Master Roien: A few days ago, I mentioned the sword handle to Blacksmith Altran over a couple of drinks, and he showed avid interest in it. He says that if only he had the blade portion , he could resurrect the sword to its original state, and suggested that since it is probably somewhere in …

links.text: Say you will perform the task

Q00255_Tutorial/30008-002.htm.text: Grand Master Roien: You have learned the basic operations of the game well. From here on out, you will be able to really enjoy the adventure! Take this gift -- I presume you have already heard instructions about how to use it? You now have a choice to make. You can either start your adventure here …

links.text: "I will go to the Kamael Village."

Q00255_Tutorial/30008-005.htm.text: Grand Master Roien: Go speak to the Newbie Guide in Kamael Village . He will advise you about what to do next, as well as give you a useful gift. To find him, just follow the arrow above your head. Farewell and good luck!

Q00255_Tutorial/30008-006.htm.text: Grand Magister Roien: Go to Talking Island Village and speak to the Newbie Guide there. He will advise you about what to do next, as well as give you a useful gift. To find him, just follow the arrow above your head. Farewell and good luck!

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
